cases.title: Rune essence
cases.semanticExcerpt: '''Rune essence''' is a raw material used in the [[Runecraft]] skill that can be crafted into low-level [[runes]], namely [[Air rune|air]], [[Mind rune|mind]], [[Water rune|water]], [[Earth rune|earth]], [[Fire rune|fire]], and [[body rune]]s. Unlike runes, rune essence does not stack. Players need [[pure essence]] to craft any other type of rune, which can only be mined in members worlds.
cases.positiveFunctionExcerpt: '''Rune essence''' is a raw material used in the [[Runecraft]] skill that can be crafted into low-level [[runes]], namely [[Air rune|air]], [[Mind rune|mind]], [[Water rune|water]], [[Earth rune|earth]], [[Fire rune|fire]], and [[body rune]]s. Unlike runes, rune essence does not stack. Players need [[pure essence]] to craft any other type of rune, which can only be mined in members worlds.
secondaryExcerpts: Free players may mine rune essence in the [[rune essence mine]], unlocked after completing the [[Rune Mysteries]] quest. To reach these mines, players need to be teleported by one of [[Rune essence mine#Teleportation and accessing the mine|several NPCs]]. In members worlds, players will also mine Rune essence until reaching level 30 [[Mining]] when they will automatically mine [[pure essence]]. Mining from one of the rocks that have an unlimited supply of essence gives 5 Mining experience per essence. A [[pickaxe]] is needed, just like any other mining activity.

cases.title: Swamp paste
cases.semanticExcerpt: '''Swamp paste''' is made by mixing [[Pot of flour|flour]] with [[swamp tar]] to make [[raw swamp paste]], and then cooking the mixture on a [[fire]], yielding 2 [[Cooking]] [[experience]]. It '''cannot''' be cooked on a [[range]]. It is possible to burn the tar, though it is automatically discarded. Swamp tar spawns in [[Lumbridge Swamp]] and [[Mort Myre Swamp]].
cases.positiveFunctionExcerpt:
Swamp paste is used in various activities:
*Fixing leaks in the [[Cabin Fever]] quest.
*Repairing the boat in the [[Sea Slug]] quest.
*Repairing the bank in the [[In Aid of the Myreque]] quest.
*Attempting to glue a page back together in [[The Slug Menace]] quest.
*Repairing the leaks in the boat in the [[Fishing Trawler]] [[Minigames|minigame]].
*Repairing the temple in the Shades of Mort'ton minigame.
*Building the rowboat in the [[Dragon Slayer II]] quest.
*A potential junk item to provide the dwarf in [[Mourning's End Part II]].
*A task for the [[Wise Old Man]].
*Creating various tiers of [[repair kits]].
secondaryExcerpts: To make a large amount of swamp paste from swamp tar, use a [[barrel of flour]] at either the [[Barrel of flour (Sinclair Mansion)|Sinclair Mansion]] or [[Barrel of flour (Gordon and Mary's farm)|Gordon and Mary's farm]]. Bring as much swamp tar as needed and 26 [[pot]]s, Gordon's farm also has a pot spawn. Click the barrel to fill the pots, then combine with the swamp tar to create raw swamp paste. Repeat this until the desired amount is obtained, then cook it. A [[Fire#Permanent fires|permanent fire]] is recommended for large amounts. There is a permanent fire at the base of Mount Karuulm, very near the fairy ring and in front of the shack with a rope spawn.

Swamp paste can also be bought from various shops, including the [[Trader Crewmember]]s at any of the ports in the [[Charter ship|Charter ship network]], the [[Khazard General Store]] (south of [[Ardougne]]), the [[Mort'ton]] [[Razmire Builders Merchants|Builder's Store]], and [[Shipwright Seb]]'s [[Seb's Shipyard Supplies|shop]] in the [[Shipyard]]. Seb's shop is the most useful, as its prices are static regardless of remaining stock.
Swamp paste also tends to be rewarded in abundance when unlocking chests within the [[Shades of Mort'ton (minigame)|Shades of Mort'ton minigame]].
Unlike [[swamp tar]], swamp paste cannot be combined with [[herb]]s to form ammunition for a [[Salamander]] using the [[Herblore]] skill.

cases.title: Oak roots
cases.semanticExcerpt: '''Oak roots''' are [[Tree roots (Farming)|roots]] that have been dug up from a [[tree patch]] by a player after growing and then chopping down an [[oak (Farming)|oak]] tree. A [[spade]] is needed to dig up these roots. The roots can be used to brew an ale called [[axeman's folly]], be used to make [[supercompost]], or spun into a [[crossbow string]]. Players can get more roots depending on their Farming level. After the roots have been dug up, [[weeds]] will begin to grow in the tree patch.

cases.title: Maple roots
cases.semanticExcerpt: '''Maple roots''' are [[Tree roots (Farming)|roots]] that have been dug up from a [[maple tree]] planted in a [[tree patch]]. It can be added to a [[Compost Bin|compost bin]] to make [[supercompost]] like all tree roots, or be spun on a [[spinning wheel]] to make a [[crossbow string]].
cases.positiveFunctionExcerpt: '''Maple roots''' are [[Tree roots (Farming)|roots]] that have been dug up from a [[maple tree]] planted in a [[tree patch]]. It can be added to a [[Compost Bin|compost bin]] to make [[supercompost]] like all tree roots, or be spun on a [[spinning wheel]] to make a [[crossbow string]].
secondaryExcerpts: Maple roots can be obtained from digging up a maple tree grown by players, requiring 45 [[Farming]], a [[maple seed]], and 45 [[Woodcutting]] to cut the tree into a stump, or as a reward from [[Vale offerings]] in the [[Vale Totems]] minigame. They must plant the seed in a [[plant pot]] filled with soil, water it from a [[watering can]], and transfer the sapling to a [[tree patch]]. After the tree has grown, they must then chop it down with an [[axe]] (to obtain [[maple logs]]), and then use a [[spade]] on the stump to dig it up. They will then receive the roots.
